name: indigen-world
description: Monorepo for the Indigen World cultural-technology ecosystem.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:web-ui && npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:admob-config && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:function-helpers && npm run test:rules && npm run test:storage-rules && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:kawuri-e2e && npm run test:contributor-e2e
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-indigen-world --only firestore "node --test firebase/tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/creator.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/contributorPortal.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/community.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/communitySpaces.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/reelsAndChats.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/learningAndShop.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/ads.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/subscriptions.rules.test.mjs firebase/tests/kawuriTasks.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:functions && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-indigen-world --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test firebase/tests/decideReview.test.mjs firebase/tests/creatorFunctions.test.mjs firebase/tests/publicForms.test.mjs firebase/tests/dictionaryAdmin.test.mjs"
scripts.test:kawuri-e2e: npm run build:functions && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-indigen-world --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "node --test firebase/tests/kawuriMediaFunctions.test.mjs"
scripts.test:function-helpers: npm run build:functions && node --test firebase/tests/functionHelpers.test.mjs firebase/tests/studioVideo.test.mjs firebase/tests/kawuriMedia.test.mjs firebase/tests/learnIllustrations.test.mjs firebase/tests/playBilling.test.mjs firebase/tests/collectionContributions.test.mjs firebase/tests/adminAudiobooks.test.mjs firebase/tests/communityNotifications.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemNameRequests.test.mjs firebase/tests/wordQueue.test.mjs firebase/tests/lexicalSenses.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemMorphology.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemHomographs.test.mjs firebase/tests/dictionaryEdits.test.mjs firebase/tests/contributionAssist.test.mjs firebase/tests/grammarRules.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemCorpus.test.mjs firebase/tests/contributorScores.test.mjs firebase/tests/restoreCredentials.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemEvidence.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemDatasetCli.test.mjs firebase/tests/contributorPayments.test.mjs
scripts.test:kasem-evidence: npm run build:functions && node --test firebase/tests/kasemEvidence.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemDatasetCli.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemCorpus.test.mjs firebase/tests/grammarRules.test.mjs firebase/tests/kasemMorphology.test.mjs
scripts.test:kasem-evidence:integration: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-indigen-world --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test firebase/tests/kasemEvidence.integration.test.mjs firebase/tests/storage.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:contributor-portal: npm run build:functions && node --test firebase/tests/contributorPortal.test.mjs firebase/tests/contributorPayments.test.mjs firebase/tests/contributorDailyTasks.test.mjs && npm test --workspace @indigen-world/tribestudio
scripts.test:contributor-e2e: npm run build:functions && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-indigen-world --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "node --test firebase/tests/contributorWorkspace.e2e.test.mjs"
